scripts.lerna:prepare: cross-env NX_NO_CLOUD=true NX_CACHE_DIRECTORY=.nx/cache NX_WORKSPACE_DATA_DIRECTORY=.nx/workspace-data lerna run prepare
scripts.lint: yarn lint:js && yarn lint:deps && yarn lint:android && yarn lint:ios:check && yarn checks:root-rn-pin
scripts.harness:expo:prebuild:ios: cd apps/build-harness-expo && NODE_PATH="$PWD/node_modules" CI=1 yarn expo prebuild --clean --platform ios
scripts.harness:expo:build:ios:debug: cd apps/build-harness-expo/ios && NODE_PATH="$PWD/../node_modules" xcodebuild -workspace RNFBExpoHarness.xcworkspace -scheme RNFBExpoHarness -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.harness:expo:build:ios:release: cd apps/build-harness-expo/ios && NODE_PATH="$PWD/../node_modules" xcodebuild -workspace RNFBExpoHarness.xcworkspace -scheme RNFBExpoHarness -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build
scripts.lint:android:
(find packages/*/android/src -name '*.java' -not -path '*/generated/*' ! -name 'ReactNativeFirebaseVersion.java' -print0 | xargs -0 google-java-format --set-exit-if-changed --replace || (echo "

android formatting error - please re-run

" && exit 1)) && (git diff --exit-code packages/*/android/src || (echo "

android files changed from linting, please examine and commit result

" && exit 1))
scripts.lint:spellcheck: spellchecker --quiet --files="docs/**/*.{md,mdx}" --dictionaries="./.spellcheck.dict.txt" --reports="spelling.json" --plugins spell indefinite-article repeated-words syntax-mentions syntax-urls frontmatter
scripts.lint:all: yarn lint && yarn lint:markdown && yarn lint:spellcheck && yarn tsc:compile
scripts.tests:packager:jet-ci: cd tests && (mkdir $HOME/.metro || true) && cross-env TMPDIR=$HOME/.metro yarn react-native start
scripts.tests:android:build:default: cd tests && yarn detox build --configuration android.emu.debug
scripts.tests:android:build:windows: cd tests && yarn detox build --configuration android.emu.debug.windows
scripts.tests:android:build:release: cd tests && yarn detox build --configuration android.emu.release
scripts.tests:android:test: cd tests && yarn detox test --configuration android.emu.debug
scripts.tests:android:test:debug: cd tests && yarn detox test --configuration android.emu.debug --inspect
scripts.tests:android:test-reuse: cd tests && yarn detox test --configuration android.emu.debug --reuse
scripts.tests:android:test-cover: cd tests && yarn detox test --configuration android.emu.debug --loglevel verbose
scripts.tests:android:test-cover-reuse: cd tests && yarn detox test --configuration android.emu.debug --reuse
scripts.tests:ios:build: cd tests && yarn detox build --configuration ios.sim.debug
scripts.tests:ios:build:release: cd tests && yarn detox build --configuration ios.sim.release
scripts.tests:ios:manual: cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 CC=clang CPLUSPLUS=clang++ LD=clang LDPLUSPLUS=clang++ yarn react-native run-ios
scripts.tests:ios:test: cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 yarn detox test --configuration ios.sim.debug --loglevel warn
scripts.tests:ios:test:release: cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 yarn detox test --configuration ios.sim.release --loglevel warn
scripts.tests:ios:test:debug: cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 yarn detox test --configuration ios.sim.debug --loglevel warn --inspect
scripts.tests:ios:test-reuse: cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 yarn detox test --configuration ios.sim.debug --reuse --loglevel warn
scripts.tests:ios:test-cover: cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 yarn detox test --configuration ios.sim.debug --loglevel verbose
scripts.tests:ios:test-cover-reuse: cd tests && SIMCTL_CHILD_GULGeneratedClassDisposeDisabled=1 yarn detox test --configuration ios.sim.debug --reuse --loglevel warn
scripts.tests:ios:pod:install: cd tests && rm -f ios/Podfile.lock && rm -rf ios/ReactNativeFirebaseDemo.xcworkspace && cd ios && pod install
scripts.lint:ruby: bundle exec --gemfile=packages/app/__tests__/Gemfile rubocop --config packages/app/__tests__/.rubocop.yml packages/app/firebase_spm.rb packages/app/firebase_json.rb packages/app/__tests__
scripts.tests:macos:pod:install: cd tests && rm -f macos/Podfile.lock && cd macos && pod install
